# Luminous

> Luminous is a free, open-source, native desktop music player for the audio library you already own — local-first, no streaming, no subscriptions, no cloud. Currently at version 2.0.

## What's New in 2.0
- Listening Stats: streaks, top artists and albums, and time-of-day listening patterns
- Redesigned Organize Files: clearer preview and destination flow when renaming and sorting your library
- Pin to Home: pin favorite artists, albums, and playlists to the Home screen
- Moment Mix: an auto-generated playlist that shifts with the time of day
- MusicBrainz Picard integration: hand off tag lookups to Picard from the tag editor
- WebDAV support: connect a WebDAV server and add its music into your library
- Artist & Album Artwork: local-artwork scanner finds artist portraits, band logos, and fanart on disk
- Social Share Cards: share what you're listening to with generated social images
- Bios & Links: add markdown bios and links to artists and albums
- Discord & ListenBrainz: share live listening as a Discord presence and scrobble to ListenBrainz

## Core Features
- Local audio library indexing with instant search across artists, albums, and songs
- Smart and auto playlists (built around decades, genres, and BPM)
- Custom genre hierarchies via drag-and-drop sub-genre organization
- Compact, always-on-top miniplayer
- Predefined and dynamic (cover-art-driven) themes
- Time-synced lyrics with inline editing
- Advanced `field:value` search syntax (e.g. `genre:rock`), savable as smart playlists
- Built-in tag editor for single or bulk metadata edits, with MusicBrainz Picard handoff
- 10-band graphic EQ with genre presets, plus a 20-band parametric EQ
- Automatic file organization into a clean artist/album folder structure
- Available in English and French

## Tech Stack & Architecture
- Framework: Tauri v2 (native — no Electron)
- Frontend: React / TypeScript / Tailwind CSS
- Core Backend: Rust
- Lightweight, no subscriptions, no data collection
